title: Be aware when breathing stops
caption:
In a sudden shock, the breath stops, and for a moment you forget your name, your worries, everything. That pause is a door.

Technique 4 of 112. When the mind stops, the breath stops. When the breath stops by itself, stay aware in that pause, and the small self vanishes.

Save this and watch for the pause today.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.
